707606.name: Fervent Castigation
707606.desc: Casting Righteous Upheaval or Blade of Faith now grants you Oath: Retribution.

707754.name: Courage

707755.name: Oathkeeper - Level 20 Passive

712437.name: Justice

When this occurs, you gain 1% increased attack speed, stacking 5 times, and the damage of abilties that consume 3 Follow Ups and Jab is increased by 0% for each stack. Decays by 1 stack every 0 sec.

800980.name: Ascend (Forward)
800980.desc: Jump into the air. After using this ability, you cannot use it again until you land.

801165.name: Temple Guardian
801165.desc: 3 Charges, 35 sec recharge Charge towards an ally, healing you and them for 188.8.

801204.name: Bells of Light

801443.name: Righteous Lunge

801445.name: Holy Cleave

801446.name: Vindication
801446.desc: Strike an enemy with zeal, dealing 34 + 28.5% AP + 35% SP Physical Damage, triggering Zealotry, and granting an Oath. Oath: Your damaging abilities have a 25% chance to trigger Zealotry.

801448.name: Benediction

801461.name: Libram of Tenacity

801465.name: Silverhand Incantation
801465.desc: Chant a silverhand incantation, generating 100 Energy and removing Sacred Restraint from yourself.

804571.desc: Charging to an ally with Temple Guardian now has a 40% chance to refresh a charge.

804680.name: Harmony
804680.desc: Reduces the range at which enemy creatures will detect you or your party members by 15 yds for 15 sec. Affected allies also gain 30% increased movement speed and can walk on water.

804761.desc: You begin to meditate for up to 8 sec. While active, you cannot move, but you and party and raid members within 0 yds will regain your Health and Mana over time. Cannot be used in Combat.

804781.desc: Pay a tithe of 1 silver to learn a special new ability to empower your entire party. Eastern Kingdoms: Northshire Abbey, Deathknell, Cathedral of Light, Scarlet Monastery, Strahnbrad, Light's Hope Chapel, The Sepulcher. Kalimdor: The Temple of the Moon, Ethel Rethor, Valley of Spirits, The Pools of Vision.. Outland: Chapel Yard, Shattrath City, Temple of Telhamat, Auchindoun, Ruins of Karabor, Oshu'gun.

804818.name: Tithe of Alacrity
804818.desc: Emanate an aura for 1 hour, empowering party and raid members with 15% reduced damage taken from area of effect attacks.

804819.name: Tithe of Mysticism
804819.desc: Emanate an aura for 1 hour, empowering party and raid members with 20% reduced pushback from taking damage while casting, and allowing 20% of mana regeneration to continue while casting.

804820.name: Tithe of Courage
804820.desc: Emanate an aura for 1 hour, empowering party and raid members with 5% increased damage against Dragons, 5% increased maximum health, and 20% reduced fear duration.

804821.desc: Emanate an aura for 1 hour, empowering party and raid members with 10% increased experience gained from professions.

805392.name: Right Hook

805394.name: Right Flank

807004.name: Tome of Light: Tranquil Circle

Each tick grants 20% increased Movement Speed and 0% increased damage until the effect ends. While active, movement speed is reduced by 30%. Also gains the Oaths of each Follow Up used in the chain.

13377892.desc: Requires Followup A fiery Follow Up that strikes up to 5 enemies for 70% Weapon Damage, plus 109 to 111 as Fire. Oath: Increases the Armor penetration of Follow Ups and Blademaster Strike by 8%.
